title: Uwo yaronse isura .
intro: Ibaze umutima wicishije bugufi wegereye umwe mu Ntumwa za Allah ufise umutima wuzuye ubugororotsi n’icipfuzo gikomeye co kwiga. Yamara muri ako kanya nyene, umuntu w’umutunzi n’icubahiro yarafashe umutima w’Intumwa, maze umutwe w’agahinda urashikirizwa uwuriko ararondera. Ivyakurikiye nta kindi vyari birenze igice cose ca Korowani, coherejwe gukosora Intumwa no gutera iteka umutima waje kurondera.
clues: Naje ku Ntumwa ya Allah mfise umutima wuguruye kandi nshaka cane kuyoborwa .
Nta kibanza c’isi nari mfise co gutanga, nari mfise umutima wicishije bugufi gusa urondera ukuri .
Amaso yanje y’umubiri ntiyashobora kubona, ariko ivyo nabona mu vy’impwemu vyari bitomoye .
Nashitse mu gihe kitabereye, igihe Intumwa yari yihutiye n’umuntu afise ububasha bukomeye .
Narahindukiriye umutwe, ariko Allah aranyishura n’ugukosorwa kw’Imana .
Ndi Abdullah ibn Umm Maktum, umugenzi w’umunyamwete inkuru yiwe yahumekeye Sura Abasa .
